headset_disclaimer_atom_copy:
MetaMarques is best experienced
 with a headset and a computer.
introduction_page_story_1: Metas are androids designed by Beta Corporation to replace biological brains. Their enhanced intelligence makes them ideal for free labor.
introduction_page_story_2: In 2033, after a series of protests, most of the world's population decided to upload their consciousness into digital frames on androids capable of executing complex tasks in their name.
introduction_page_story_3: With the work benefits going to their respective owners.
introduction_page_story_4: In that same year, the labour market collapsed and led to the rise of MetaMarques Industries, specialized in Synthetic Humans, by using the user uploaded consciousness, creating replaceable on-demand beings who obey without question.
introduction_page_story_5: The MetaMarques Industries are the largest company in the world, and the only one that can afford to create and maintain the Synthetic Humans.
introduction_page_story_6: The latest model released poses as a replica of Gonçalo Marques, a MX-1000 synth.
